verdict: Workday: Choose Workday when enterprise HCM on one employee record is the job and you will fund a custom quote plus implementation — not when you need published SMB PEPM, simple US payroll, or frontline WFM. Scores use the HR editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Named AI in the HCM suite
weaknesses: WFM not the UKG-class hourly thesis
bestFor: Enterprises (typically 1,000+ employees) that want one HCM system of record
Global HR + payroll programmes comparing Workday as the default shortlist

notIdealFor: SMB teams that need published PEPM (BambooHR) or payroll (Gusto)
Hourly WFM-first buyers (UKG Pro / Dayforce / Connecteam)
Buyers who will not take a custom enterprise quote
tradeoffs: Published free tiers vs paid depth for ATS, WFM, time, or training jobs
Hub / multi-module pricing complexity vs single-product floors

recommendation: Choose Workday when enterprise HCM on one employee record is the job and you will fund a custom quote plus implementation — not when you need published SMB PEPM, simple US payroll, or frontline WFM. Compare Oracle Cloud HCM for Fusion-stack enterprises, UKG Pro or Dayforce for WFM-heavy HCM, Rippling for HR+IT unification at smaller scale, and BambooHR/Gusto if the real job is SMB HRIS or payroll.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine HR editorial criteria using the category weights (hiring/workforce fit 15, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, value 12, mobile/frontline 10, scalability 9, analytics 8, AI 8), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ATS, core HRIS, payroll/benefits, people-platform, enterprise HCM, frontline WFM, time & attendance, SOP training, and LMS peers are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
